en: Colorized panoramic view over a forested valley town filled with grand spa-era buildings and villas. The town is nestled among wooded hills, with many multi‑story historic structures with red and gray roofs. At the top left in red text is the word "Marienbad." At the top right in red text is the phrase "Blick vom Café Egerländer." The image has the typical printed style and layout of an early 20th‑century postcard.
